summary: Tested the frontend only, per the request: the landing page, the 3 CTAs going to /quote, the full 7-step wizard (step tabs, next and back buttons, localStorage persistence across reload), and Step 7 (analysing state, 6 exposure bars, overall band, narrative, Zurich recommendations with premium range, confidence and drivers, considerations, JSON download, edit buttons). Ran 4 scenarios: Manufacturing, Transport+vehicles (with public liability held and a prior claim), IT, and Professional. Everything works and there were zero console or page errors. Outputs change with inputs as expected. The main problem is relevance: every business also gets products meant for other sectors.

ui_bugs.issue: Grammar: the IT category reads 'As a it and technology business' because categoryLabel().toLowerCase() makes IT lowercase and the article is always 'a'. Should read 'As an IT and technology business'.

integration_issues.issue: Products meant for other sectors get recommended. Products are kept if relevance > 0, so a priority match alone (+2 each) is enough even with no industry match. Seen: Manufacturing gets contractors-combined (construction only), office-surgery and property-owners (real estate only). IT gets contractors-combined and shop (retail/hospitality), and 'Potential gap' badges make them look urgent. Transport gets tradespeople.

issues: Line 2 always says '...which is why continuity and liability score the way they do', even when both are only Moderate or Low (e.g. Transport). Make it depend on the actual scores.

passed: Landing: header shows ComplyStack / Powered by Zurich, hero, 12 product-card-*, and hero/header/cta-quote-btn all present
All 3 'Get a quote online' buttons go to /quote and show Step 1

Wizard: business-name-input, category-manufacturing, headcount/revenue pills (revenue--5-25-crore double-dash slug confirmed), priorities, ownership, location-type, fire-protection, has-insurance-yes, insurance-type-*, has-claim-yes all work
back-btn keeps answers; step-tab-7 jumps; answers and URL survive reload (localStorage)
Step 7: analysing-phases appears, then results show after ~2s
exposure-area-property/liability/continuity/people/motor/cyber render with level and factors; overall band shows

Transport+vehicles: Motor is Elevated (others Low/Moderate); small-fleet and marine-cargo are top 2 and marked Recommended + Potential gap; claim loading and the 'already hold some cover' narrative line appear
IT gets office-surgery first, Cyber Moderate. Professional gets office-surgery first, Cyber Elevated. Transport Cyber is Low.
Manufacturing gets commercial-combined first (₹1.8 L–₹2.5 L, Confidence Medium, Turnover driver) and combined-liability in the top 3
summary-download-btn downloads <name>-protection-summary.json; considerations-list shows; edit-insurance-btn goes to Step 5; edit-business-btn goes to Step 1 with the name kept
No console errors across the landing page and all journeys
action_items: recommendProducts: require an industry match (or a minimum relevance of 3) before recommending a product, so no-industry-match products like contractors-combined, shop and property-owners stop showing for unrelated sectors. Alternatively, never show them as 'Potential gap' without an industry match.
buildNarrative: fix the 'a it' grammar (choose a/an and keep the 'IT' capitals)
buildNarrative: make the turnover/headcount line say which areas actually score highest instead of always naming continuity and liability
critical_code_review_comments: riskEngine.recommendProducts: the `p.coverTypes.length <= covers.length` check in alreadyHas is redundant

deriveInputs: revenue 'Not sure' falls back to ₹1.5 Cr and headcount 'Not sure' to 4, but confidence still shows 'High' because revenueBand/headcount are truthy. Treat 'Not sure' as missing in the confidence calculation.
IT cyber score stops at 54 (Moderate, just below Elevated at 55), while property can reach High for an IT business. Consider weighting cyber higher for it/professional.
Step7Summary: the useEffect deps array is empty and the analysing state runs on every mount. This is fine but adds a 1.9s delay every time Step 7 is revisited.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all flows work; recommendation relevance logic needs refinement)

seed_data_creation: None. Test businesses with the TEST_ prefix were stored only in browser localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only app. Routes: / (Landing) and /quote (Journey). Pill testids are slugified and the ₹ symbol gives a leading double dash, e.g. revenue--1-5-crore, payroll--5-15-lakh. Headcount uses headcount-11-20, headcount-21-50. To retest: check that Manufacturing and IT no longer get contractors-combined, shop or property-owners, and that the IT narrative reads 'an IT'.
